Patient Follow-ups

Health check-ins on day 3 and day 7

Sends "How are you feeling now?" with Feeling fine / Still have symptoms buttons. A "Still have symptoms" reply gets your clinic's phone number. Needs the approved patient_health_checkin WhatsApp template.

A message sent automatically after a patient's visit — the thing that makes this more than a booking bot. Visits are closed out automatically each night, so nobody has to mark anything.

1 = the next day. Retried for 3 days if WhatsApp refuses the first attempt.
0/700 characters
A follow-up always arrives outside WhatsApp's 24-hour reply window, so Meta only allows an approved template. To send the wording above, get a template approved with two variables — {{1}} the patient's first name and {{2}} your message — and put its name here. Leave this empty and the built-in follow-up is sent instead; your custom wording will not be delivered.

Data & Support

Bring your existing patient list from your old software, download your data as Excel-ready CSV, and message the Kriya team.

Patient data storage Loading…

Import your existing patients

Export the patient list from your old software as a CSV file (in Excel: File → Save As → CSV). Only a Name column is required; Phone, Patient ID, Gender, Date of Birth (DD/MM/YYYY), Age, Email, Address, Last Visit and Notes are picked up automatically, and any other columns are kept as extra notes. Importing the same file again never creates duplicates. Imported patients are not sent WhatsApp messages.

        IPD Setup

        Wards, beds and daily bed tariffs (rupees per day, per bed category).

        Billing settings

        Bed-day rule: every IST calendar day in a bed counts; once a discharge is started, the last day is not charged if it ends before the cut-off hour. Confirm this matches your hospital's tariff policy before go-live.

        Above these limits a discount waits for a clinic administrator. Nobody approves their own request.

        Packages

        A package is one fixed price. Charges in its included categories, dated within its days, are covered; other categories and later days are billed as usual. Changing a package never re-prices a stay it was already applied to.

        Bulk Import Diagnostic Catalog

        Upload a CSV file to create or update diagnostic tests and pricing.

        Specifications & Policy:
        • Required Columns: name, price_rupees
        • Optional Columns: category, sample_type, turnaround_hours, fasting_required, prep_instructions
        • Service type: set it below to file the whole file at once, or add a category column to set it per row. A file with neither leaves existing service types untouched.
        • Limits: Max 5 MB file size & 25,000 data rows.
        • Atomic Guarantee: If any row fails validation, zero changes are saved to the database.

        This is how a centre actually holds its catalogue: one export per section. Upload pathology, then health packages, then radiology — each under its own service type. Patients then choose the service type first instead of scrolling one endless list.

        Import Diagnostic Price List

        Upload a price list (PDF, XLSX, CSV, PNG, or JPG) up to 10 MB. Files are processed in the background and held in preview for 24 hours until you approve and apply them.

        Supported Formats & Safety Limits:
        • Formats: Excel (.xlsx), CSV, PDF (up to 30 pages), Images (PNG, JPG)
        • Upload Limits: Max 10 MB upload size; OCR limited to 10 pages; legacy .xls must be saved as .xlsx or CSV
        • Staging Guarantee: Zero unapproved writes to your live catalogue. You review every row before applying.
